—Illya's voice had not arrived at precisely that moment, I might have plunged headlong into sickeningly sweet romance, morning or no morning.

“A-anyway, I'm going to eat breakfast! W-we'll talk about this later!”

I pivot like a machine and set off for the living room.

Forcing my stiff and awkward limbs to move, I somehow drive the lust that has taken over my mind into a distant corner.
